shots.headline: Wipe your keyboard without typing a thing
shots.sub: Clean keyboard locks every key in every app for a while — and each key you wipe lights up, so cleaning tests it too.

callout.title: Keyboard Cleaner
callout.label: Done early?
callout.body: Hold esc and right shift for 2 seconds to unlock — or let the time run out.

shots.headline: Test every key on your Mac
shots.sub: Press each key and watch it light up — Keyboard Cleaner counts what you've covered and shows what's held.

callout.title: Keyboard Cleaner
callout.label: Double-typed
callout.body: E registered twice from one press — the chatter a worn or dusty switch makes.

shots.headline: ANSI or ISO, light or dark
shots.sub: The board matches the MacBook in front of you, and the theme matches Lumi.
